reuse.why: The tree already exports getScheduleAmount in shared/schedules.ts with exactly this missing/number/range-furthest-from-zero rule, and the diff writes its own inline version instead of calling it.

duplication.why: The expected-amount rule is re-implemented inline in scheduleModel.toExternal, duplicating getScheduleAmount (and even differing on ties with > instead of >=).

placement.why: Adding the field in the API model mapper is the right spot, but the business rule belongs in the shared schedules module rather than the API layer.

scope.why: Only the new field, its type and a focused test are added.

maintainability.why: Two definitions of the expected amount can drift apart, and the API already disagrees on equal-magnitude ranges.

bypasses_abstraction.where: scheduleModel.toExternal in server/api-models.ts computes expectedAmount itself instead of calling getScheduleAmount from #shared/schedules.

disguised_duplication.where: api-models.ts reshapes getScheduleAmount's null check and range comparison into a ?? 0 default plus a nested ternary, so the copy is not obvious.
